gloss: to be dyed; to be stained; to be tainted

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {染|そ}まっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be dyed; to be colored
definitions.explanation: For something to take on color from dye or its surroundings.

definitions.gloss: to be tainted; to be influenced
definitions.explanation: To be negatively influenced by an environment or bad company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧{染|そ}まった。
examples.english: The mountains were dyed red with autumn leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まって⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: He became tainted by bad habits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まっている。
examples.english: The sky is tinged with the colors of sunset.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まって⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}れなくなった→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Having been influenced by city life, I can no longer go back to the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧{染|そ}まった。
examples.english: The white cloth was dyed red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{悪|あく}→悪：10459_aku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まって⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: He has been completely corrupted by evil.

notes:
{染|そ}まる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to be dyed or influenced.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧ (to dye)
- {染|そ}まる: The cloth is dyed.
- ⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: I dye the cloth.

ASPECT (ている):
{染|そ}まっている indicates something has been dyed/tainted and remains so.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[color]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まる — [thing] is dyed [color]
- [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[influence]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まる — [person] is tainted by [influence]
- ⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧{染|そ}まる (be dyed red)
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まる (be stained with blood)
- ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まる (be corrupted by city life)
- ⟦{悪|あく}→悪：10459_aku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|そ}まる (be tainted by evil)

USAGE:
The "tainted by bad influence" meaning is common, implying someone has become corrupted or changed negatively by their environment.
